definition: Any V[d] >= threshold * mean(V[d-40:d]) for d in D-20..D-1; 60 complete preceding market-session observations and positive means required
missing: Missing rows and invalid volumes remain unknown; observed zero volume is included
history_flags: share and zero-volume flags use D-60..D-1; they do not change the main signal; missing share counts are flagged separately
event_labels: Copied from input without relabeling; results depend on supplied event and eligibility definitions
rate_denominator: evaluable_count; unknown histories are not treated as no signal

entries.next_open: D+1 open; horizon 1 is the same-day close

return_definition: Product of close/(close-change), a reference-linked price proxy; not verified total return
observation_policy: Observed contiguous path and tradable endpoint required; missing is not zero return or confirmed delisting
limitations: No execution guarantee, cash dividends, rights cash flows or delisting recovery
Future path selection changes the sample; not a return lower bound
Signal frequency conditional on events is not future-event precision
Repeated events and overlapping horizons are not independent observations
